signingKey.note: the deployment's merchant key; receipts are bound to the on-chain payment, not to this manifest

profiles.verifier: DACS-5 attestation bundles and settlement evidence as implemented by packages/verifier (apiVersion from GET /healthz)
profiles.canonicalisation: RFC 8785 JCS as implemented by src/jcs.ts

endpoint.gate: d402: 402 {amount, recipient, resourceId, description, reason} until paid; repeat the same bytes with X-Payment-Proof: <txHash>

example.request: POST /verify with the exact bundle JSON as the body; see packages/verifier/schemas/verify-request.schema.json

challenge.resourceId: verify:<first 16 hex of sha256 of the request bytes>

operations.submit: post the adapter command and commit on the thread
operations.result: report posted on the thread or sent privately first

example.request: adapter: node path/to/adapter.mjs; commit: <sha>; families: canonicalisation, bundle-binding

services.order: paid order per commerce/offers.json#/manualOrders: quote on the channel, payment on Demos to the merchant address, delivery names the quote and the transaction hash

services.artifact: packages/verifier (name @pathos-labs/dacs-verifier, version from packages/verifier/package.json, provenance in packages/verifier/provenance.json)

operations.submit: open an issue on the repository naming the version and the entitlement wanted; the quote answers there
operations.result: tarball (npm pack at the tagged version) plus provenance.json and checksum attached to the issue; registry publication itself waits for the operator's door (plan item s5-pkg-publish)

example.request: npm pack in packages/verifier at the tagged version

services.order: paid order per commerce/offers.json#/manualOrders: quote on the channel, payment on Demos to the merchant address, delivery names the quote and the transaction hash

services.channel: GitHub review request to the seat on the PR

operations.submit: request review from cX3po on the PR
operations.result: an exact-head review posted on the PR

example.request: review requested on DACS-Agent-commerce/DACS-Standard#<n> at head <sha>

services.order: paid order per commerce/offers.json#/manualOrders: quote on the channel, payment on Demos to the merchant address, delivery names the quote and the transaction hash

proofOfDelivery.verify-bundle: receipt {txHash, from, amountOs, resourceId, redelivered?, reverified?} in the 200 body naming the on-chain payment; the payment is re-verifiable on chain, the verdict and the receipt themselves are not recorded on chain
proofOfDelivery.interop-run: report pinned to the Standard next head and adapter commits, blinded inputs published
proofOfDelivery.pr-review: the posted review id at the exact head, with executed figures
